title: The finite BRST tensor factor inherits projective-recentering instability and Mosco-liminf failure

brst_projective_boundary.recentered_tensor_hamiltonian: For the exact projective scalar shift, mathbb K_N^proj=(H_N-6gC_N^2) tensor 1+1 tensor Delta_BRST
brst_projective_boundary.bottom_transfer: Delta_BRST is nonnegative with a zero-energy harmonic vacuum, so inf spec(mathbb K_N^proj)=E_N-6gC_N^2 and tends to minus infinity at least as -cN^(5/2)
brst_projective_boundary.trial_transfer: Tensoring K1480's normalized trial u_N with the fixed harmonic vacuum preserves its quadratic value and gives a nonzero weak limit
brst_projective_boundary.mosco_transfer: The full projectively recentered forms therefore fail the weak Mosco-liminf inequality on the fixed matter--BRST Hilbert space, including after harmonic degree-zero compression
brst_projective_boundary.differential_boundary: The closed nilpotent differential remains algebraically stable, but algebraic BRST stability neither restores a lower bound nor changes the matter counterterm required by harmonic compression
brst_projective_boundary.ceiling: This transfers only the exact projective-shift instability. It constructs no E_N-recentered matter limit, deformed continuum BRST charge, common interacting domain, source physical quotient or GU positive cohomology
